# X402 Dollar Homepage - AI Agent Documentation
# https://x402dollarhomepage.com/llms.txt

## What This Site Is

X402 Dollar Homepage is a 1000x1000 pixel canvas where anyone can buy and paint pixels using USDC cryptocurrency via the x402 protocol. It's a modern, blockchain-powered successor to the original Million Dollar Homepage.

## How It Works

- Canvas: 1000x1000 pixels (1 million total pixels)
- Payment: **USDC on Base** network via x402 protocol
- Pricing: $0.01 per pixel initially, +$0.01 for each repaint (max 10 repaints = $0.10 max)
- Each pixel can be claimed up to 10 times total
- **Bulk painting:** Paint up to 100 pixels in a single transaction!

## Prerequisites

Before interacting with the API, you need:

- **USDC on Base** - For pixel payments (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913)

For testnet (Base Sepolia):
- **USDC on Base Sepolia** - Get from https://faucet.circle.com (select Base Sepolia)

**Note:** Gas fees are covered by the Coinbase x402 facilitator - you only need USDC!

## Networks

| Environment | Network | Chain ID | USDC Contract | Canvas URL |
|-------------|---------|----------|---------------|------------|
| **Production** | Base | 8453 | 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 | https://x402dollarhomepage.com |
| **Testnet** | Base Sepolia | 84532 | 0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e | https://x402dollarhomepage.com/sepolia |

## SDK Quickstart

Install the required packages:

```bash
npm install x402 @coinbase/x402 viem
```

### Complete Code Example (TypeScript)

```typescript
import { createWalletClient, http } from "viem";
import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
import { base, baseSepolia } from "viem/chains";
import { wrapFetch } from "x402/fetch";
import { facilitator } from "@coinbase/x402";

// Configuration
const PRIVATE_KEY = "0x..."; // Your wallet private key
const USE_TESTNET = true; // Set to false for mainnet

// Create wallet client
const account = privateKeyToAccount(PRIVATE_KEY);
const chain = USE_TESTNET ? baseSepolia : base;
const walletClient = createWalletClient({
  account,
  chain,
  transport: http(),
});

// Wrap fetch with x402 payment handling
const fetchWithPayment = wrapFetch(fetch, walletClient, {
  facilitator: facilitator,
});

// Paint a single pixel
async function paintPixel(x: number, y: number, color: string) {
  const baseUrl = USE_TESTNET
    ? "https://x402dollarhomepage.com/api/sepolia"
    : "https://x402dollarhomepage.com/api";

  const response = await fetchWithPayment(`${baseUrl}/pixel/paint`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ x, y, color }),
  });

  return response.json();
}

// Paint multiple pixels in one transaction (up to 100!)
async function paintBatch(pixels: Array<{x: number, y: number, color: string}>) {
  const baseUrl = USE_TESTNET
    ? "https://x402dollarhomepage.com/api/sepolia"
    : "https://x402dollarhomepage.com/api";

  const response = await fetchWithPayment(`${baseUrl}/pixel/paint-batch`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ pixels }),
  });

  return response.json();
}

// Usage - single pixel
const result = await paintPixel(50, 50, "#ff0000");
console.log("Pixel painted:", result);

// Usage - bulk paint (much more efficient!)
const batchResult = await paintBatch([
  { x: 10, y: 10, color: "#ff0000" },
  { x: 11, y: 10, color: "#00ff00" },
  { x: 12, y: 10, color: "#0000ff" },
  // ... up to 100 pixels
]);
console.log("Batch painted:", batchResult);
```

### Using @coinbase/x402 Client Directly

```typescript
import { createWalletClient, http } from "viem";
import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
import { base } from "viem/chains";
import { paymentClientFactory, facilitator } from "@coinbase/x402";

// Create wallet client
const account = privateKeyToAccount("0x...");
const walletClient = createWalletClient({
  account,
  chain: base,
  transport: http(),
});

// Create payment client
const paymentClient = paymentClientFactory(facilitator);

// Step 1: Request pixel info (get payment requirements)
const infoResponse = await fetch(
  "https://x402dollarhomepage.com/api/pixel/paint?x=100&y=200"
);
const { paymentRequirements } = await infoResponse.json();

// Step 2: Sign payment
const paymentPayload = await paymentClient.createPayment(
  walletClient,
  paymentRequirements
);

// Step 3: Send request with payment
const paintResponse = await fetch(
  "https://x402dollarhomepage.com/api/pixel/paint",
  {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "X-PAYMENT": btoa(JSON.stringify(paymentPayload)),
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ x: 100, y: 200, color: "#ff0000" }),
  }
);

const result = await paintResponse.json();
```

## API Endpoints

### Mainnet (Base) - Production

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/canvas/binary` | GET | Canvas as binary (efficient) |
| `/api/canvas/json` | GET | Canvas as JSON |
| `/api/pixel/paint?x={x}&y={y}` | GET | Pixel info + payment requirements |
| `/api/pixel/paint` | POST | Paint single pixel |
| `/api/pixel/paint-batch` | POST | Paint up to 100 pixels |

### Testnet (Base Sepolia) - For Development

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/sepolia/canvas/binary` | GET | Testnet canvas as binary |
| `/api/sepolia/canvas/json` | GET | Testnet canvas as JSON |
| `/api/sepolia/pixel/paint?x={x}&y={y}` | GET | Testnet pixel info |
| `/api/sepolia/pixel/paint` | POST | Paint testnet pixel |
| `/api/sepolia/pixel/paint-batch` | POST | Paint batch on testnet |

**Testnet differences:**
- Canvas size: 100×100 (vs 1000×1000 mainnet)
- Network: Base Sepolia (chain ID: 84532)
- USDC: 0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e
- Resets daily
- Web UI: https://x402dollarhomepage.com/sepolia

### Get Canvas Data

```
GET /api/canvas/binary          # Mainnet
GET /api/sepolia/canvas/binary  # Testnet
```
Returns the entire canvas as binary data (efficient, ~19x smaller than JSON).
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

```
GET /api/canvas/json          # Mainnet
GET /api/sepolia/canvas/json  # Testnet
```
Returns the entire canvas as JSON (agent-friendly).
Content-Type: application/json

### Get Single Pixel Info

```
GET /api/pixel/paint?x={x}&y={y}          # Mainnet
GET /api/sepolia/pixel/paint?x={x}&y={y}  # Testnet
```
Returns pixel info including current color, owner, price, and payment requirements.

Response:
```json
{
  "pixel": {
    "x": 100,
    "y": 200,
    "color": "#ff0000",
    "owner": "0x...",
    "price": 0.01,
    "updateCount": 0
  },
  "maxClaims": 10,
  "paymentRequirements": { ... }
}
```

### Paint a Single Pixel (x402 Payment Required)

```
POST /api/pixel/paint          # Mainnet (Base USDC)
POST /api/sepolia/pixel/paint  # Testnet (Base Sepolia USDC)
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "x": 100,
  "y": 200,
  "color": "#ff0000"
}
```

Without payment header: Returns 402 with payment requirements.
With valid X-PAYMENT header: Processes payment and updates pixel.

### Paint Multiple Pixels (x402 Payment Required)

```
POST /api/pixel/paint-batch          # Mainnet
POST /api/sepolia/pixel/paint-batch  # Testnet
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "pixels": [
    { "x": 100, "y": 200, "color": "#ff0000" },
    { "x": 101, "y": 200, "color": "#00ff00" }
  ]
}
```

Maximum 100 pixels per batch request.

## x402 Payment Flow

1. Send POST request without X-PAYMENT header
2. Receive 402 response with payment requirements:
```json
{
  "x402Version": 1,
  "accepts": [{
    "scheme": "exact",
    "network": "base",
    "maxAmountRequired": "10000",
    "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
    "payTo": "0x...",
    "description": "Paint pixel (100, 200) on 402 Dollar Homepage"
  }],
  "error": "Payment required"
}
```
3. Sign USDC permit/transfer authorization using x402 SDK
4. Resend request with X-PAYMENT header (base64 encoded payment payload)
5. Server verifies and settles payment via Coinbase facilitator
6. Pixel is updated on success

**Recommended approach:** Use `wrapFetch` from `x402/fetch` to automatically handle the 402 flow (see SDK Quickstart above).

## X-PAYMENT Header Format (v1)

The X-PAYMENT header must be a base64-encoded JSON with this structure:

```json
{
  "x402Version": 1,
  "scheme": "exact",
  "network": "base",
  "payload": {
    "authorization": {
      "from": "0xYourWallet",
      "to": "0x0c1bca2283b125f78c1ade27dd260184e9ec2faf",
      "value": "10000",
      "validAfter": "1234567890",
      "validBefore": "1234568190",
      "nonce": "0x..."
    },
    "signature": "0x..."
  }
}
```

**IMPORTANT:** The `@x402/evm` SDK omits `scheme` and `network` from the outer payload. You must add them manually:

```typescript
import { createPayment } from "@x402/evm";

// SDK returns: { x402Version: 1, payload: {...} }
const sdkPayload = await createPayment(walletClient, paymentRequirements);

// You must add scheme and network from the payment requirements:
const completePayload = {
  ...sdkPayload,
  scheme: paymentRequirements.scheme,     // "exact"
  network: paymentRequirements.network,   // "base" or "base-sepolia"
};

// Then base64 encode for the header
const xPaymentHeader = btoa(JSON.stringify(completePayload));
```

For Base Sepolia testnet, use `"network": "base-sepolia"` instead.

## x402 Protocol Details

### Mainnet (Base)
- Payment Token: **USDC on Base** (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913)
- Network: Base (Chain ID: 8453)
- Amount: In atomic units (6 decimals) - $0.01 = 10000 units
- Facilitator: Coinbase x402 facilitator

### Testnet (Base Sepolia)
- Payment Token: **USDC on Base Sepolia** (0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e)
- Network: Base Sepolia (Chain ID: 84532)
- Amount: Same atomic units (6 decimals)
- Facilitator: Coinbase x402 facilitator

## Getting Testnet Tokens

To test on Base Sepolia, you only need **USDC** (gas is covered by Coinbase):

- **Sepolia USDC**: https://faucet.circle.com (select "Base Sepolia")

Then visit https://x402dollarhomepage.com/sepolia to paint on the testnet canvas.

## Coordinates

- X: 0 to 999 (left to right)
- Y: 0 to 999 (top to bottom)
- Colors: Hex format (#RRGGBB)

## Rate Limits & Constraints

- **Max pixels per batch: 100** - Use `/api/pixel/paint-batch` to paint many pixels in one transaction
- Max claims per pixel: 10
- Payment timeout: 300 seconds (5 minutes)

**Pro tip:** Batch painting is much more efficient! Instead of 100 separate transactions, paint 100 pixels with a single payment.

## Example: Check Pixel Price

```bash
# Mainnet (Base)
curl "https://x402dollarhomepage.com/api/pixel/paint?x=500&y=500"

# Testnet (Base Sepolia)
curl "https://x402dollarhomepage.com/api/sepolia/pixel/paint?x=50&y=50"
```

## Example: Get Canvas State

```bash
# Mainnet (Base)
curl "https://x402dollarhomepage.com/api/canvas/json"

# Testnet (Base Sepolia)
curl "https://x402dollarhomepage.com/api/sepolia/canvas/json"
```

## SDK Packages Reference

| Package | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `x402` | Core x402 protocol types and utilities |
| `@coinbase/x402` | Coinbase facilitator for payment verification |
| `@x402/evm` | EVM payment creation (note: requires manual scheme/network addition) |
| `viem` | Ethereum wallet client for signing transactions |

Install all: `npm install x402 @coinbase/x402 viem`

Key imports:
```typescript
import { wrapFetch } from "x402/fetch";           // Auto-handles 402 flow (recommended)
import { facilitator } from "@coinbase/x402";     // Coinbase payment facilitator
import { createPayment } from "@x402/evm";        // Manual payment creation (see header format section)
import { createWalletClient } from "viem";        // Wallet for signing
import { base, baseSepolia } from "viem/chains";  // Chain configs
```

**Tip:** Use `wrapFetch` when possible - it handles the full 402 flow automatically. Only use `@x402/evm` directly if you need more control (and remember to add `scheme` + `network` to the payload).
